official_structure_semantics.Price Indicator: field before Price; blank means normal price
official_structure_semantics.Price: official structure permits space/blank through numeric range; a blank carries no usable numeric endpoint price

corrections.root_cause: The earlier v5 holiday extractor used fixed positional indices compatible with the later 10-field layout: row[7] as Price and row[8] as Msg Code. In the legacy 12-field layout row[7] is Price Indicator, row[8] is Price, and row[9] is Msg Code; legacy trades are coded Y rather than T. This mechanically caused early legacy CN archives to report zero parsed trades.
corrections.rule: resolve fields from normalized header names; treat Y as the official legacy trade code and T as the later trade code; never treat S settlement as a trade

corrections.discovered_from: the first formal 2015 ordinary-session extraction, before any v6 target model execution
corrections.observed_failure: 43 required 2015 archives failed with ValueError converting an empty Price string, producing only 162/237 usable ordinary events
corrections.official_basis: the legacy TickData_structure.dat explicitly permits a space/blank Price field
corrections.root_cause: the schema-aware parser correctly identified Y as Traded but still required every normal Y record to contain a numeric Price; a single official blank-price Y record therefore invalidated an otherwise usable archive
corrections.frozen_rule: a normal Y/T record with blank Price is counted as blank_price_trade_rows and skipped as a price endpoint; the rest of that archive remains eligible. Nonblank invalid numeric prices still fail. Model results may not choose this rule.
corrections.scope: data-contract repair only; rerun 2015 extraction only because 2016-2020 artifacts did not exhibit this failure

frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.column_resolution: resolve fields by normalized header names, not fixed absolute indices
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.legacy_trade_code: Y when the official legacy schema/header identifies the 12-field Price-Ind/Amend layout
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.later_trade_code: T when the later schema/header identifies the traded code T
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.settlement_code: S is not a trade and must never be used as an endpoint
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.amendment_policy: only normal records with blank Amend Code may form endpoints; nonblank amendment records are conservatively excluded
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.blank_price_policy: official blank-price Y/T records cannot form numeric endpoints and are skipped record-by-record rather than invalidating the whole archive
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.price_normalization: for nonblank numeric prices preserve the frozen CN rule: if raw numeric price >100000 divide by 100 exactly once; final sanity range 1000..50000

v5_preservation.note: The frozen v5 candidate remains historical evidence exactly as sealed. Phase 6 uses the corrected official schema for its new ordinary-session A50 dataset; it does not retroactively change the v5 receipt.
